title: Normalized higher pullback tensor constraints
statement: Using [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], retain the parent definitions of the integral, rational and common-stage pullback compositors, tensor associators, braidings, units and unitors, and their prescribed component equations. The integral constraints are uniquely specified by fully faithful coherent reduction; rational constraints are their scalar localizations; common-stage constraints are their normalized finite-field representatives. The unit constructibility and normalization, integral and rational associativity and braiding, and prescribed reduction equations have their existing proofs. The six remaining named existence-and-uniqueness statements are common-stage composition, associator, braiding, both unitors, and the rational scalar unit comparison. Each is uniquely normalized by its stated representative or scalar condition.

source.place: Tag 07A4 and the recorded parent coefficient-coherence argument

proof.text: Prove the uniqueness halves by obtaining each representative from its corresponding existence theorem and comparing two candidates with Iso.ext. For composition compare at M.stage; for associator and braiding compare at a finite coefficient compositum of the two prescribed stages.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4; elaboration and factoring of the parent normalization argument

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackTensorCommonComposition_existsUnique {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y) :
    ∃! e : ((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ Z Y (h ≫ f) hZ hY)).obj M ≅
      ((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)).obj (((@commonStageDerivedPullback l _
        Ω _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M),
      ∀ (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hM : M.stage ≤ L),
        HEq e.hom (ofHom (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω (h ≫ f) M)
          (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω h (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f M)) L hM hM
          ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω (h ≫ f) M L hM).hom ≫
            ((@pullbackTensorRationalComposition l _
              (_root_.WeilConjectures.AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ X
              Y Z f h hX hY
              hZ)
              (M.toStage hM)).hom ≫
            ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _
              (_root_.WeilConjectures.AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ Z
              X h hZ hX)).map
              (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f M L hM).inv ≫
            (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω h
              (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f M) L hM).inv))
